## Community course proposal — unofficial

- Race name and catalogue ID:
- Edition year:
- Official distance in km:
- Source URL:
- Redistribution licence or explicit permission:
- Required attribution:
- Known deviations, GPS gaps, map limitations and print-fit notes:

Attach the ZIP from the app (**Suggest this course → Prepare ZIP**) to this description. If it is too large to attach, provide a public download link with permission for us to redistribute it.

- [ ] I have permission to publish and redistribute the submitted files with the stated credits.
- [ ] I inspected the files and removed private locations, timestamps and personal data, including embedded 3MF source metadata.
- [ ] I understand this issue and its attachments are public.
- [ ] I understand this is unofficial and requires maintainer review before publication.

An automatic **course intake report** comment will check the ZIP. Maintainers: complete the report's checklist, then add the `approve-course` label to open a pull request automatically. Only merging that pull request publishes the course.
